verdict.rationale: Apple's macOS pages describe a built-in Siri AI that can take actions in apps like Messages, Music and Reminders based on context. Examples include editing a sent message and adding a song to a playlist. It can also act on screenshots of on-screen content, draft or critique writing, hold back-and-forth conversations in a dedicated app, and be invoked from Spotlight. That covers the core of delegating tasks to a built-in assistant. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the actions work as claimed, evidence of multi-step or longer-running task delegation beyond single-app examples, and in-depth first-party documentation beyond marketing snippets.
